question: Which fast food is closest when progressing from University of North Georgia (Oconee Campus), Watkinsville, GA toward Alberta Banks Park, Flowery Branch, GA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.42624 33.866134)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.926325 34.202543)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.42624 33.866134)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.42624 33.866134)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: University of North Georgia (Oconee Campus), Watkinsville, GA

[3].display_name: Alberta Banks Park, Flowery Branch, GA
